draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Glad to hear things are going well, and thanks for the kind words on onboarding in your ticket -- still open on our side, so to answer it directly: yes, seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

On the layout: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the thing that makes everything else click. When you're ready, teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Want me to walk you through setting up that first project on a short call this week?

Best,
Nadia
